lines: Ah, a new face. Welcome to Hoshimachi.
The shrine bell didn't ring this evening. First time in forty years.
And something has been shuffling round the torii since sundown.
My knees won't take those steps. Would you go up and look?
The shrine is straight up the path. Mind yourself.
You chased it off? Listen...
*bong*
There it is! Forty-one years, then.
Thank you. Hoshimachi owes you one. Come back tomorrow: bells are not the only thing going quiet round here.
Tea's on me, any time.
Evening. Quiet night.
Well. Quiet apart from the shrine. I'm not paid enough for ghosts.
Going up there? Tap the thing and stand your ground. Guard when it swings.
You went up there? Brave. Or silly. I'll write 'brave'.
Hoshimachi police. Mostly lost umbrellas.
Everyone says the thing at the shrine is just old Mr. Kondo in a mask.
I'm not going up there to check, though.
You're going? Take a photo! Actually, don't.
So was it Mr. Kondo?
...A zombie in a suit. That's worse.
Tomorrow I'm going to be brave too. Probably.
Last train's gone. Again.
If I see one more spreadsheet I'll start shuffling round shrines myself.

foes.name: Shambling salaryman
foes.intro: A shambling salaryman blocks the torii!
foes.defeat: The salaryman groans, drops his briefcase and shuffles off home.
